pages.title: Incubator
pages.text: The <item>incubator/$ has two purposes. It can create <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/syringe#potions)genetic plasmids/$, and it can create <item>spawn eggs/$ from <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning#process)embryos/$, making it the final stage of the <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning)cloning process/$.$(br2)To create <item>genetic plasmids/$, it uses 1 <item>mutagen/$ and 1 (vanilla chicken) egg. <item>Genetic plasmids/$ will spoil after 30 minutes.$(br2)To create <item>spawn

<item>eggs/$, it uses 1 (<thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/spoilage)non-spoiled/$) <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning#process)embryo/$ and 1 (vanilla chicken) egg.$(br2)The process can take a long time- potentially long enough for the ingredients to <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/spoilage)spoil/$. The rate it works at is based on the <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/heat)temperature/$. It connects to <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/heat)heat cables/$ on any side.$(br2)The <item>incubator/$ doesn't use heat, but wants to be as close to 33.333°C as possible. The more times the digit 3 appears in the <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/heat)temperature

<thing>$(l:essentials:intro/heat)/$, the faster it goes. It also adds <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning#attributes)quality/$ to creates clones- the less time it took to craft, the more it adds.
